title: PageLayout
description: A single page of a Rainstorms story. Matches the PageData model in backend/server.py. Contains the prose text, illustration prompt, and structural metadata for one book page.

outline_beat.description: The story beat for this page, taken from the blueprint outline. Read-only reference for the author.
examples: Oliver is tucked in bed but hears his baby brother Max fussing. He reaches for his old blanket.

page_text.description: The final prose text for this page. Picture-book style: 2–5 sentences, simple vivid language for the target age range.
examples: Oliver snuggled deep in his cozy bed, but sleep wouldn't come. From the nursery next door, he heard a tiny whimper. Baby Max was fussing again.

illustration_prompt.description: Detailed scene description for an illustrator or image-generation model. Includes character appearances, setting, mood, and art style.
examples: A cozy bedroom at night with warm lamp light. A young boy with messy brown hair sits up in bed wearing star-pattern pajamas, looking toward the door with caring concern. Style: soft watercolor children's book illustration, warm cinematic lighting, expressive characters, bedtime-friendly palette

emotional_beat.description: Short mood descriptor for this page — used in Story Memory and as a generation hint

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 last-updated timestamp (changes on each autosave)

examples.outline_beat: Oliver is tucked in bed but hears his baby brother Max fussing. He reaches for his old blanket.
examples.page_text: Oliver snuggled deep in his cozy bed, but sleep wouldn't come. From the nursery next door, he heard a tiny whimper. Baby Max was fussing again. Oliver reached for his old baby blanket — the soft, silver-blue one that always made him feel brave.
examples.illustration_prompt: A cozy bedroom at night with warm lamp light. A young boy with messy brown hair sits up in bed wearing star-pattern pajamas, looking toward the door with caring concern. His hand reaches for a shimmering silver-blue blanket at the foot of his bed. Style: soft watercolor children's book illustration, warm cinematic lighting, expressive characters, bedtime-friendly palette
